regulation_excerpt: The board of directors shall include at least one independent director with expertise in risk management and shall meet at least quarterly.
rationale: Internal Governance and Corporate Structure policy explicitly mandates an independent risk director and quarterly cadence.

regulation_excerpt: Insurers shall establish a Risk Management Committee chaired by an independent director with documented terms of reference.
rationale: The committee exists but the policy does not require an independent chair.

regulation_excerpt: All privileged user accounts shall require multi-factor authentication and session activity must be logged and reviewed.
rationale: Cyber Insurance Policy mandates MFA + privileged session logging.

regulation_excerpt: Encryption keys must be rotated at intervals not exceeding twelve months and rotation events must be auditable.
rationale: Policy mentions encryption but not key rotation.

regulation_excerpt: Cyber incident reporting to the regulator shall occur within forty-eight hours of detection.
rationale: Policy requires incident reporting but does not state the 48-hour SLA.

regulation_excerpt: Insurers shall maintain a board-approved Risk Appetite Statement reviewed at least annually.
rationale: Risk Management policy includes annual board-approved RAS.

regulation_excerpt: All material outsourcing arrangements shall be assessed for concentration risk and reported to the board.
rationale: Outsourcing assessed; concentration risk reporting not explicit.

regulation_excerpt: Grievances shall be acknowledged within three working days and resolved within fifteen working days.
rationale: Grievance redressal SOP states identical SLAs.

regulation_excerpt: Insurers shall publish quarterly grievance redressal statistics on their public website.
rationale: Policy is silent on public quarterly publication.

regulation_excerpt: Quota share reinsurance treaties shall specify the cession percentage and the maximum cession limit per risk.
rationale: Quota Share Reinsurance Agreement template covers both.

regulation_excerpt: Surplus share treaties shall include a definition of retained line and a cap on the number of lines ceded.
rationale: Surplus Share Reinsurance Agreement covers both.

regulation_excerpt: Non-proportional reinsurance treaties must define attachment point, exhaustion limit, and reinstatement provisions.
rationale: Non Proportional Reinsurance Agreement defines all three.

regulation_excerpt: The internal audit charter shall be approved by the board audit committee and reviewed annually.
rationale: Charter exists; annual review not explicitly required.

regulation_excerpt: Internal audit shall report functionally to the audit committee and administratively to the CEO.
rationale: Internal audit policy mirrors this exact reporting structure.

regulation_excerpt: Insurers shall maintain a fraud risk register and update it at least quarterly.
rationale: Fraud Prevention SOP mandates quarterly fraud risk register updates.

regulation_excerpt: Suspected internal fraud must be reported to the regulator within seven days of confirmation.
rationale: Policy lacks the regulator-notification SLA for internal fraud.

regulation_excerpt: Underwriting guidelines shall include exclusions for prohibited risks and require senior underwriter sign-off above defined limits.
rationale: Underwriting policy includes both.

regulation_excerpt: Underwriting decisions for cyber-exposed risks shall include a documented cyber risk assessment.
rationale: Cyber assessment recommended but not mandatory in current policy.

regulation_excerpt: Insurers shall maintain a documented investment policy approved by the board of directors.
rationale: Internal investment policy is board-approved.

regulation_excerpt: Marketing materials shall not make misleading claims about policy benefits and shall be reviewed by compliance prior to publication.
rationale: Misleading-claim prohibition present; pre-publication compliance review not explicit.
